evidence: Publisher run 45178555446 re-downloaded the artifact, matched the SHA-256, verified the signer with apksigner and the package/version/label with aapt, uploaded as a draft, matched the GitHub asset digest and size, then published; the public 0.21 APK was byte-checked identical before and after.
